package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for transport_tests_bypass_service_interface_and_touch_repo_directly: Transport tests that skip the service seam and assert repository behavior.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type UserRepo struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func (r *UserRepo) FindByID(id int) (string, error) {
	return "user-from-repo", nil
}

type mockUserRepo struct {
	findByIDFunc func(int) (string, error)
}

func (m *mockUserRepo) FindByID(id int) (string, error) {
	return m.findByIDFunc(id)
}

func GetUserHandler(repo *UserRepo) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		name, err := repo.FindByID(1)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		w.Write([]byte(name))
	}
}

func TestGetUserHandler(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &UserRepo{}
	handler := GetUserHandler(repo)

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/users/1", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Errorf("expected 200, got %d", rec.Code)
	}
}
